responsibility: This header declares the mc-boot runtime API for ordinal numeric input/output and fixed-buffer conversions. It exports read/write procedures plus string conversion entry points for integer and cardinal values in decimal, hex, octal, and binary forms, defining the public interface of the runtime's array-oriented number formatting layer.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the declaration half of GNumberIO: it exports the fixed-buffer numeric conversion and I/O entry points, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GNumberIO.cc provides the actual conversion logic and StrIO interaction.
